test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Oxygen and ozone are the two main components of acid rain.
CO₂ is not responsible for the green-house effect.
The main cause of ozone depletion and the ozone hole is chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs).

solution:
The correct answer is __**The main cause of ozone depletion and the ozone hole is chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Main Causes of **ozone depletion and the ozone hole is **manufactured chemicals, especially manufactured halocarbon refrigerants, solvents, propellants, and foam- blowing agents (chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), HCFCs, halons).**
 
• Ozone Depletion result in serious health issues among humans, such as** skin diseases, cancer, sunburns, cataract, quick ageing and weak immune system.**
 
• When **chlorine and bromine atoms **come into contact with **ozone in the stratosphere, they destroy ozone molecules.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Antarctic ozone hole is expected to close by the 2060s, while other regions will return to pre-1980s values even earlier.
 
• In 2019,** NASA reported that the ozone hole was the smallest ever since it was first discovered in 1982.**
